title: Combination Sum IV
statement:
Given an array of distinct positive integers nums and a target integer target, return the number of possible combinations that sum to target.

A combination is a selection of items where order matters (i.e., sequences with the same elements in different orders are counted separately). For example, [1, 2] and [2, 1] are different combinations.

You may use each element from nums an unlimited number of times.
constraints: All elements of nums are distinct
